_help: Day 2, room 5: the garden, 'The first years' (1960-1963). The wedding time on the sundial, the seed jars, the first lemon at the little table. See docs/STORY.md.

locks._why: The old key to the shed was in the garden table drawer.
hints: The old key from the garden table opens the shed door.
Select the old key, then tap the shed door.

locks._why: Big hand on the nine, little hand nearly at eleven: a quarter to eleven, and 'the garden has kept our time' points at the sundial.
hints: What tells the time in a garden?
The wedding memory in the lemon tree is about the sundial.
Big hand on 9, little hand nearly on 11: a quarter to eleven.

locks._why: Beans (leaf) first; tomatoes (heart) just before sunflowers (sun); radishes (shell) not last: leaf, shell, heart, sun.
hints: The first spring had an order. Who insisted on what?
The first spring note is about the row of seed jars on the shed wall.

locks._why: Chloé pants in the sun; the water jug was behind the seed jars. She drops a memory when she's had a drink.
hints: Chloé is panting in the sun.
She needs water: the jug was behind the seed jars.
Select the water jug, then tap Chloé.

locks._why: The first lemon's note is buried under the roses; only Chloé digs.
hints: The soil under the thorny ones is soft.
Chloé could dig under the roses.
Tap Chloé, then tap the soil under the roses.

locks._why: Their only guests: the daisies in the jar (5), the birds on the trellis (3), and the two chairs: 5, 3, 2.
hints: Who sat at the little table with them?
The daisies, the birds and the chairs belong to the garden table drawer.

clues.text: A jam jar of daisies on the garden table.
A little painting of birds, hung on the trellis where the real ones sit.
